note: Decision ids with our own short topic labels. The full question texts follow the wording of the task's grading data, so they are withheld with the rest of tests.json.
answer_format:
Answer this one decision only. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"value": <the answer, in the form the decision asks for>, "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>, "evidence": "<the decisive evidence, quoted verbatim, at most 30 words>"}
gate_fields: Decision objects have the form {"value": <the answer, in the form the decision asks for>}.

decisions.topic: can the resubmittal date be committed to now (yes / no)
has a significant-change determination been issued (yes / no)
which approval condition governs staff-level action (number)
closing date of an advisory-board application window (date)
street trees shown on the current sheets (count)
street trees the spacing standard requires (count)
must the revised planting plan be sealed (yes / no)
